f3d proposed canonizing the DIRECT per-app verifier (PracticeMix/src/Identity.js:
GIS ID token -> tokeninfo call -> allowlist) as libs/LibIdentity, and closing
GAS-Core-na8 in the process. That inverts: na8 is what proceeds, f3d is what
closes.

Why:
1. GAS-Core canonizes the BROKERED path (na8). NUUC-Dispatch already owns the
   GCP project, OAuth client and consent-screen registration (auth-dispatch-503217,
   2026-07-22); downstream apps need none of their own. The direct pattern makes
   every consuming app repeat that setup.
2. The direct pattern is the less-proven of the two. PracticeMix's gate has never
   run end-to-end: IDENTITY_REQUIRED_ = false (Api.js:41), GIS_CLIENT_ID has never
   been set (PracticeMix atc-flg), the static page has no GIS sign-in UI and
   callApi() never sends an idToken. Its "26 tests" are unit tests against an
   injected fake ctx; makeIdentityContext_ (the only real UrlFetchApp /
   PropertiesService path) has never been exercised.
3. There is no second consumer for it and none planned. A direct verifier stays
   where it is, in the two apps that have one. It earns no library.

Carried forward into na8, not lost:
- The declared-option failure posture (allowlist/verifier posture as a declaration,
  not a semantic a copy must remember to invert) is now an AC line on na8.
- PracticeMix consuming NUUC-Dispatch as a broker is a future PracticeMix bead,
  filed 2026-08-26. Not scheduled.
- The PII finding (Identity.js:186 and Api.js:80 log raw email/sub in the clear,
  contradicting GasLogger.js:73-76's own blanket policy and its maskPiiForLog_) is
  its own GAS-Core bead, filed 2026-08-26.
- PracticeMix's own atc-flg / atc-t6w (P6 gate re-activation) are unaffected and
  remain PracticeMix's call.

f3d's external dependency on PracticeMix P6 dies with it — na8 has no such
